# mooncake mod tidy

Fetch every declared module and pin its hash in mooncake.modules.lock

## Description

Reads the playbook's modules: block, fetches each reference,
and writes its content hash to mooncake.modules.lock next to the playbook.
Entries for modules no longer declared are dropped.

A Git tag is a mutable pointer — the same @v1.2.0 can resolve to different trees
on two machines. The lockfile pins the tree behind the tag, and any run that
finds a lockfile verifies against it.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--playbook` | string | - | Path to the mooncake.yml to read (default: ./mooncake.yml) |
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
